f3_program: collection("cara.bag.marbles", "marble", "bag", source("60 marbles in a bag"))
observe(at("cara.bag.marbles.count", "current"), 60, "count", source("Cara has 60 marbles in a bag"))
observe(at("cara.bag.marbles.yellow.count", "current"), 20, "count", source("20 of them are yellow"))
fraction_of(at("cara.bag.marbles.green.count", "current"), at("cara.bag.marbles.yellow.count", "current"), 1, 2, source("half as many are green"))
same(at("cara.bag.marbles.red.count", "current"), at("cara.bag.marbles.blue.count", "current"), source("equally divided between red and blue"))

sum_relation(at("cara.bag.marbles.count", "current"), at("cara.bag.marbles.yellow.count", "current"), at("cara.bag.marbles.green.count", "current"), at("cara.bag.marbles.red.count", "current"), at("cara.bag.marbles.blue.count", "current"), source("20 of them are yellow, half as many are green, and the remaining marbles are equally divided between red and blue"))
query("percentage_ratio", at("cara.bag.marbles.blue.count", "current"), at("cara.bag.marbles.count", "current"))
collection("school_home_route.ground.popcorn", "popcorn_kernel", "ground", source("the popcorn on the ground"))
observe(at("jenny.school_home.distance", "current"), 5000, "foot", source("Jenny lives 5000 feet from her school"))
observe(at("jenny.popcorn.drop_rate.kernel_count", "that_day"), 1, "count", source("1 kernel of popcorn per 25 feet she walked"))
observe(at("jenny.popcorn.drop_rate.distance", "that_day"), 25, "foot", source("1 kernel of popcorn per 25 feet she walked"))

quotient_relation(at("jenny.popcorn.drop_rate", "that_day"), at("jenny.popcorn.drop_rate.kernel_count", "that_day"), at("jenny.popcorn.drop_rate.distance", "that_day"), source("1 kernel of popcorn per 25 feet she walked"))

rate_relation("jenny.popcorn.dropped.count", at("jenny.popcorn.drop_rate", "that_day"), at("jenny.school_home.distance", "current"), source("One day as she was walking home from school, she dropped 1 kernel of popcorn per 25 feet she walked"))
add("drop_popcorn", "jenny", at("school_home_route.ground.popcorn.count", "current"), "jenny.popcorn.dropped.count", source("she dropped 1 kernel of popcorn per 25 feet she walked"))

consume("squirrel_eats_popcorn", "squirrel", at("school_home_route.ground.popcorn.count", "current"), fraction(event_field("drop_popcorn", "quantity"), 1, 4), source("a squirrel came and ate one-quarter of the popcorn Jenny had dropped on her way home"))
query("remaining_count", "school_home_route.ground.popcorn", "following_morning")
assumptions: Jenny's walk home spans the stated school-to-home distance.

f3_program: collection("chandra.monster_sightings", "monster", "castle grounds", source("lost monsters all around the castle grounds for the last 5 days"))
observe(at("chandra.monster_sightings.duration", "current"), 5, "day", source("for the last 5 days"))
observe(at("chandra.monster_sightings.count", "day_1"), 2, "count", source("On the first day she saw 2 monsters"))
multiple(at("chandra.monster_sightings.count", "day_2"), at("chandra.monster_sightings.count", "day_1"), 2, source("Every day after that she saw double the amount as the day before"))
multiple(at("chandra.monster_sightings.count", "day_3"), at("chandra.monster_sightings.count", "day_2"), 2, source("Every day after that she saw double the amount as the day before"))
multiple(at("chandra.monster_sightings.count", "day_4"), at("chandra.monster_sightings.count", "day_3"), 2, source("Every day after that she saw double the amount as the day before"))
multiple(at("chandra.monster_sightings.count", "day_5"), at("chandra.monster_sightings.count", "day_4"), 2, source("Every day after that she saw double the amount as the day before"))
query("sum", "chandra.monster_sightings", "after_5_days")
assumptions: The monsters sighted across the five days are the monsters Chandra needs to return.

f3_program: observe(at("brendan.pay.amount", "june"), 5000, "dollar", source("In June, he earned $5000"))
add("june_pay", "brendan", at("brendan.available_money.amount", "current"), at("brendan.pay.amount", "june"), source("In June, he earned $5000"))
fraction_of(at("brendan.debit_card.recharge.amount", "june"), at("brendan.pay.amount", "june"), 1, 2, source("he recharges his debit card with half of his pay"))

transfer("debit_card_recharge", "brendan", at("brendan.available_money.amount", "current"), at("brendan.debit_card.balance", "current"), at("brendan.debit_card.recharge.amount", "june"), source("he recharges his debit card with half of his pay"))
observe(at("brendan.used_car.value", "purchase"), 1500, "dollar", source("a used car worth $1500"))
remove("buy_used_car", "brendan", at("brendan.available_money.amount", "current"), at("brendan.used_car.value", "purchase"), source("bought himself a used car worth $1500"))
query("value", at("brendan.available_money.amount", "end_of_june"))
assumptions: The half-pay recharge rule applies to Brendan's aggregate June pay.
Remaining money means money outside the debit-card balance.
The used car's stated worth is the amount paid for it.

f3_program: collection("jan.barrel.water", "water", "barrel outside her home", source("water in a barrel outside her home"))
add("collect_rainwater", "jan", at("jan.barrel.water.amount", "current"), 65, source("Jan collected 65 gallons of water in a barrel outside her home"))
observe(at("jan.car_cleaning.water_per_car", "current"), 7, "gallon_per_car", source("7 gallons of water each"))
observe(at("jan.cars.count", "current"), 2, "count", source("the two cars"))
product_relation("jan.car_cleaning.water.amount", at("jan.car_cleaning.water_per_car", "current"), at("jan.cars.count", "current"), source("She uses 7 gallons of water each to clean the two cars"))
consume("clean_cars", "jan", at("jan.barrel.water.amount", "current"), "jan.car_cleaning.water.amount", source("She uses 7 gallons of water each to clean the two cars"))
offset("jan.plant_watering.water.amount", "jan.car_cleaning.water.amount", -11, "gallon", source("uses 11 fewer gallons than the two cars to water the plants"))
consume("water_plants", "jan", at("jan.barrel.water.amount", "current"), "jan.plant_watering.water.amount", source("uses 11 fewer gallons than the two cars to water the plants"))

consume("wash_plates_and_clothes", "jan", at("jan.barrel.water.amount", "current"), fraction(at("jan.barrel.water.amount", "current"), 1, 2), source("she uses half of the remaining gallons of water to wash the plates and clothes"))
query("value", event_field("wash_plates_and_clothes", "quantity"))
